title: Complete north-star owner: all original7761 lines, later notices and source-count discrepancies
head: 2ddf2f0ea4b7d5eb10d7fc3a947d76da2739f748

reviews.classification: complete large life-sim north-star palette and successive user/source corrections, explicit coverage discrepancies and current-owner scope
reviews.disposition:
This completes B444–B449's cumulative partial review. All7,761 original lines and the100 appended notice lines were read. Original input still matches B444's recorded SHA as an unchanged7,761-line prefix. Fresh continuation read6,281–7,861 in bounded ranges; one truncated span inside the already authored B446 notice was recovered by a complete7,796–7,812 reread before full credit. Earlier partial ledgers retain their original input identities, ranges and then-open remainder; their “continue at” instructions are now historical. This owner remains a broad palette with later authority notices, not a newly adopted specification.

**What the final original range adds.** Complete coverage includes direct-recreation/ability-personification frames; all collected/D2/open-decision notes; six installed-source summaries and P-S/P-D/P-NW findings; minigame M1–M3 and zoom ladders; MG01–MG10 plus investing/property contracts; B1/B2 and all15-by5 body/family translation cells, the seven-step tree example and12 additional-body rows; divergence D1–D8; all eight nonhuman-research patterns and strongest-idea rows; P6–P10; the five ongoing supplied-book findings/P29–P32/C1–C29; every final pointer and EL1–EL21 everyday-place round, with EL22–EL41 retained as a pointer rather than a read linked body. No illustrative table or source report becomes implemented merely because it was reviewed.

**Later material already rejects several early universal claims.** The Er Gen/divergence section explicitly names selection/prompt bias, related author families, MTL/cutoff/missing-source limits and supplied-note rather than fresh-source evidence. It preserves irreversible local tradeoffs, conflicting identities, restoration that can displace another person, successful actions harming infrastructure, knowledge that is erased and ordinary lives that resist becoming resources. A global palette of possible routes is not a promise that every individual can reverse every outcome. Directly granted competence and actual retained sources qualify understand→practice→execute and blanket foreign weakening. D8 preserves jokes, grief, ordinary work and quiet scenes without compulsory progression points. Keep these as qualified source counterexamples and optional design operations, not mandatory harm, coercion, loss or a fresh consensus across independent authors.

The nonhuman research is secondary, with no complete novel read and explicit thin/unverified examples. “The genre's main failure”, always-matching threats, late/costly human avatars, never-empty offline time, one channel ladder and mandatory changing verbs are evaluative proposals, not measured genre laws or new gates. Rumor/concept starts can be early. A body's form, senses, actual means and chosen world decide what it can do: the75 translation examples do not prove automatic body support, guaranteed actions for every family or universal immobility. B1's visible grey unlock rule is qualified by current [UI rules](UI_RULES.md), observer knowledge and actual supported routes; a six-slot schema does not implement new mechanisms without handlers. The later P6–P10 section already permits genuine superiority, overlapping/fusion-preserved methods, partial body changes, descriptive texture and narrow code handlers.

**Economic examples preserve actual rights and settlements.** MG01–MG10 are possible pursuits, not a mandate for a stock market, every asset's problems or a parallel economy. Loans, shares, future-goods purchases and patronage have different claims; cash, inventory, receivables and actual distributable profits are distinct. One enterprise pays from one recorded amount, and intervention changes real inputs rather than adding unrelated graph noise. Property ownership/occupancy/alteration/leasing, occupants' choices and inheritance stay separate. Delegation follows actual instructions, stock, capacity, clock and commitment boundaries. The connected workshop/room example explicitly does not select Frontier or promise the proposed browser/persistence checks have run. Minigame auto-resolution, manual variance, small-first zoom ladders and mandatory migration per feature remain proposals applied to an actual selected change, not additional gates for every ordinary detail.

**Five-book source claims and carriers remain local.** 巫師你好，我是偽人, 一年抽取一詞條, 咒回：特級的我去死滅打宿儺了！, 全人類的繼承者 and 廢土邊境檢查官 were ongoing works in the cited snapshot; “read in full” there cannot mean finished stories or current publication coverage. P29's imperfect-copy default, P32's mandatory blind spot, life-level caps, fixed slots, substrate loss and resource scaling are source-local/proposed conditions, not universal limits on perfect copying or absolute powers. The user's actual clash correction distinguishes placement/theme from one effect blocking another's trigger. C1–C29 preserve carrier, ownership, clocks, source, activation and actual interactions; a clash need not involve one carrier, and moving a property does not automatically resolve every cross-carrier dependency. Death need not destroy the whole body or leave every other carrier intact; a soul/ownership right does not universally survive every rewind or necessarily transfer to an heir. Redirection, order, narrowing, fusion, splitting, shared/backup carriers and clocks each need the actual mechanism and settlement. The cited carrier-change explanation marked inferred stays inferred. Optional anchors do not become compulsory substitutes for the price-free cheats already allowed.

**Another specific counting gap remains visible.** The Royal Road pointer calls its atlas161 tropes but gives99 covered+47 partial+10 new=156, leaving5 unaccounted in that summary. [Task-local arithmetic](audits/reconciliation-2026-11-04/northstar-catalog-arithmetic-b450.json) checks that calculation only; it does not prove the underlying atlas lacks rows or that the categories were intended to be exhaustive. Retain this alongside B448's approximately120 versus197 listed chapter-number discrepancy until the actual source receipts clarify them. No guessed completion, omitted category or chapter count is silently supplied.

**Use the current owners and preserve this history.** EL1 already corrects the idea that ordinary life had never been considered; EL2 labels the experience-connection gap as inference rather than a measured runtime defect. EL3–EL21 preserve local recognition, source-aware memory, real shared time, means, texture and actual supported absence history, without a new familiarity meter or obligatory population simulation. The narrower old NPC-heavy-work priority is not a ban on every small authored place. Current [PROJECT](../PROJECT.md), [direction](USER_VISION.md), [lead-life workflow](LEAD_LIFE_RULES.md), [architecture](ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md), [presentation](PRESENTATION_AND_FOURTH_WALL.md) and [skills/learning](SKILLS_AND_LEARNING_CONSIDERATIONS_2026-10-18.md) govern selected execution. Old launch/open-decision/model/budget/lane tables, body/clock/runtime absence claims, screenshots-to-be, packaging/storage suggestions and human-review language retain their dates; no repeat approval, worker, acquisition or gameplay assignment follows. The historical “accepted first milestone” is retired, own-status and current UI direction remain, and no blanket proposal uptake is created.

Full review preserves all useful options and original text while qualifying their authority and proof. Reopen a source gap or palette row for a named actual consumer, keeping source-local IDs and exact evidence boundaries. This documentation pass ran no gameplay implementation, primary-novel/PDF read, private-corpus change, test/build/browser, personal-save access, install/removal, live-worker action, deletion, relocation, commit or push.

Fresh6281–6480,6481–6680,6681–6880,6881–7080,7081–7280,7281–7480,7481–7680,7681–7861; output truncated only within B446 appended notice, recovered complete7796–7812. Full original and all100 notice lines covered. Arithmetic receipt checks pointer sum156 versus stated161 only. No primary/source-code/runtime proof renewed.
